name: Dirk van den Berg
title: VP Network Operations & Infrastructure
notes: Oversees core network architecture and signaling infrastructure modernization. Prioritizes SS7/Diameter optimization to reduce intercarrier roaming fraud and improve 4G/5G signaling capacity for the Dutch market.

name: Marieke Jansen
title: Director, Telecom Services & Roaming
notes: Manages international roaming agreements and SMS interworking with 120+ carriers across Europe. Advocates for IMS convergence to streamline voice, SMS, and data signaling across NewNet Communications platforms.

name: Pieter Mertens
title: Senior Manager, Signaling Systems & Standards
notes: Responsible for 3GPP standards compliance and next-gen signaling architecture roadmap. Evaluates LTE/5G signaling protocol updates and seeks vendor solutions that support Diameter/SIP scalability without legacy SS7 dependencies.

name: Anke Klomp
title: Head of Network Security & Compliance
notes: Focuses on GDPR compliance, signaling security, and threat mitigation for telecom infrastructure. Requires robust security certifications and audit trails for any signaling software changes, which may slow NewNet adoption if security requirements are not clearly demonstrated.
